hold.clamp: Retain body grip. With spindle stopped, screw the cap fully home by hand on clean threads and confirm shoulder-to-mouth seating before the facing tool approaches.
hold.grip_on: same sound excess tube tail as setup T2; cap held only by the source threaded seat
hold.note: HOLD until actual thread engagement, seating, cut direction and retention under tool load are established. Verify the forward cutting direction tightens the right-hand thread; crossing the axis reverses torque and can unscrew the cap. Never cross the spindle centre; stop if the cap moves. Safe thread retention remains unresolved.

findings.subject: A1

findings.message: A2: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, deburr_mm, stock_state.od_mm, stock_state.north_end_z.

hold.clamp: Grip the protected excess tail, indicate the base at the four-jaw, then use the rolling-bearing aligner at the free end only after approving a safe alignment procedure. Withdraw the bearing and all indicator equipment completely before cutting.
hold.grip_on: excess solid tail beyond the selected closed body base and final parting plane
hold.note: HOLD until grip, stickout, runout, bending/deflection, wall thickness, thread seating, actual cut load and chuck/tool clearance are approved for this unsupported assembly. The roughly 0.005-inch alignment TIR shown is not a finished tolerance or safe limit. Withdraw the aligning bearing before turning; it is not continuous support.

findings.subject: A2

findings.message: A3: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, deburr_mm, stock_state.od_mm, stock_state.north_end_z.

hold.clamp: Retain the tail grip, set the parting blade square and on centre with minimum projection, and hand-turn the chuck to check all clearances.
hold.grip_on: same sound excess tail as A2
hold.note: HOLD until actual blade width/edge reference, parting position relative to the blind floor, cap seating and safe separated-part retention are established. Do not catch the tube beside a running chuck. Base thickness is nominally 12.7 mm; measure actual stock and bore-tip position.

findings.subject: A3

hold.clamp: Retain or safely re-establish the remnant grip. Verify enough stock remains for a 12.7-mm male stub, 12.7-mm head, actual kerf, facing allowance and sound jaw contact.
hold.grip_on: sound P3 chuck-side remnant behind cap head and parting allowance
hold.note: HOLD while cap blank diameter, shoulder position, die fit, tool centre height or jaw/holder clearance is unknown. Set the turning tool square with clearance on both shoulder and OD; a broad tool edge is not automatically a qualified form tool. Stop spindle and prevent powered rotation for die cutting.

hold.note: Hand-held, away from stopped machinery. Remove loose chips without forcing them into threads; do not use this leaded-steel example for food contact. No performance or pressure rating is established.

findings.subject: F1

findings.message: P1: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, deburr_mm, stock_state.od_mm, stock_state.north_end_z, stock_state.south_end_z.

hold.clamp: Clamp the sound round bar in fixtures.four-jaw; remove the key and turn the chuck by hand to establish complete tool and jaw clearance.
hold.grip_on: sound unmachined bar behind the irregular end
hold.note: HOLD until engagement, stock projection, jaw position and tool centre height are established. No gloves near a rotating spindle. Keep hands and loose items clear.

findings.subject: P1

hold.clamp: Pull out enough stock for the complete tube, excess for later gripping and final part-off; re-clamp and apply the live centre to its centre seat with appropriate light support.
hold.grip_on: sound raw bar behind the long tube blank and future parting plane
hold.note: HOLD: establish actual excess, grip, centre-seat fit/angle, quill extension and deflection/clearance. Allow the suggested couple of extra inches only after measuring enough stock for the actual grip and parting allowance; that suggestion is not a safe projection limit.

findings.message: P3: holding declarations need hold.stop, hold.grip_mm, deburr_mm, stock_state.od_mm, stock_state.north_end_z.

hold.clamp: Retain the bar clamping, withdraw centre pressure, and verify parting-blade centre height, square setting, minimal projection and full chuck/holder clearance.
hold.grip_on: same sound bar in the chuck; tube projects beyond the parting plane
hold.note: HOLD until a safe parting plane, blade width, tube retention and catch arrangement are established. Do not catch or retrieve a loose cutoff near a rotating chuck.

hold.note: HOLD: measure usable drill flute/reach, drill point, actual blank length, intended hole depth, tap lead and bottom clearance before drilling. z.face: seated cap outer face, referred to body mouth datum
z.method: Touch the actual cap outer face and establish remaining head stock from its seated shoulder; selected final head length is 12.7 mm. Do not assume the raw part-off face is already at Z12.7.

readout.debt: mechanical dial calibration and dial-to-part registration are unverified; source graduations and nominal targets do not establish physical dial settings
readout.procedure: Use the mechanical handwheel/quill scales and separate dial indicator. Before cutting, establish each scale's graduation, motion sense, backlash and repeatable final approach. Do not reverse onto an uncorrected dial mark or transfer another tool's setting without its stated touch. HOLD until per-tool pickup and compensation are established.

tool_touches.method: After op 20, touch the standing outside head face with spindle stopped and establish this chamfer bit's axial reference. tool_touches.x_method: With spindle stopped and cap securely seated, measure its actual head OD using the caliper and establish this chamfer bit's radial contact/reference. HOLD until bit geometry, contact compensation and actual setting are established; do not inherit a different tool's setting.
